requestedIntent: Reassess the ACEF Cockpit direction and specify a v1 read-only state viewer (acef-cockpit-status JSON + terminal table) designed around dev-done-vs-product-done visibility.
limitations: No acef-cockpit* script exists in scripts/; the JSON contract and terminal table are specified only.

The product_done and decision_queue fields depend on canonical persona-walk and product-risk artifacts whose repo-level locations are not yet standardized; the CLI cannot be built until those paths are pinned.
Context compiler and tool proxy are deferred out of v1 (token-cost motivation superseded by v2 measurements; context-mode covers bounded tool output today).
Execution shell (worktrees, terminals, agent launching) is explicitly bought, not built — Nimbalyst/Conductor-class tools, UI/execution only, no gate/state authority.

evidence.note: Three-product split with per-piece disposition and the rationale from v2 measurements and the O2 cycle.
Bounded JSON contract including product_done (persona-walk evidence, self_certified_only, stale_evidence) and decision_queue (product-risk DECISION/UNVERIFIED items).
